# 4-H Botsmiths `FtcRobotController` Template

This repo contains the necessary configuration for compiling deploys via GitHub actions and configuring a dev environment for Android Java development

## Getting Started

**This is assuming that you have already forked the Template repo for the current season. If not, check out the [ADMIN.README.md](../TeamDocs/ADMIN.README.md)**

1. [Setup your editor](../TeamDocs/SETTING%20UP%20YOUR%20EDITOR.md) (either via codespaces/vscode/docker)
2. [Deploying Your Code](../TeamDocs/DEPLOY%20YOUR%20CODE.md) - How to make changes to your code and merge them into the `master` branch
3. [The Deploy Process](../TeamDocs/THE%20DEPLOY%20PROCESS.md) - How the code is built and deployed to the robot
